name: soloagile
description: Agile for one person and Claude: every project gets a private page with a board, plan, reports, release notes, docs and links, kept current as the work happens.

save_at_session_end.title: Commit and push at session end
save_at_session_end.description: When a session ends, commit and push the board and the handoff note (pm/*.md, NEXT_SESSION.md, QUESTIONS.md) if they changed. Nothing else is committed. Off unless you turn it on.
